scripts.build: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build:ts && cd ../.. && npm run test:build-gate
scripts.build:offline: cd packages/tui && npm run build && cd ../telemetry && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../session-backends/sqlite-node && npm run build && cd ../../protocol && npm run build && cd ../client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build
scripts.check: biome check --write --error-on-warnings . && npm run check:changelog && npm run check:pinned-deps && npm run check:ts-imports && npm run check:shrinkwrap && npm run check:install-lock:coding-agent && tsc --noEmit && npm run check:browser-smoke
scripts.lint:arch:all: depcruise packages/agent/src packages/ai/src packages/coding-agent/src packages/server/src packages/tui/src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts && npm run shrinkwrap:coding-agent && npm run install-lock:coding-agent
scripts.generate:models: npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-models && npm --prefix packages/ai run generate-image-models
scripts.test: npm run test:scripts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:build-gate: npm run test:system-prompt && npm run test:cache-stability && npm run test:loader-resolver && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:my-pi-extensions
scripts.test:cache-stability: npm --prefix packages/ai run test -- test/anthropic-defer-loading.test.ts test/anthropic-tool-serialization-stable.test.ts test/transform-messages-copilot-openai-to-anthropic.test.ts test/openai-codex-defer-loading.test.ts && npm --prefix packages/coding-agent run test -- test/extensions-hook-api.test.ts test/model-resolve-filter.test.ts test/agent-child-auto-routing.test.ts test/suite/regressions/cache-break-builtin-preservation.test.ts test/suite/regressions/deferred-tool-activation-refresh.test.ts
scripts.test:system-prompt: npm --prefix packages/ai run test -- test/anthropic-system-prompt-boundary.test.ts && npm --prefix packages/coding-agent run test -- test/system-prompt.test.ts test/suite/agent-tool-context-modes.test.ts test/suite/extensions/fork-agent.test.ts
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.version:major: npm version major --workspaces --no-git-tag-version --no-workspaces-update && node scripts/sync-versions.js && npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run clean && npm run build && npm run check
